verse.verse_1: Qaf. By the Qur'an glorious, We have sent thee as a warner.
verse.verse_2: Aye! they marvel that there hath come Unto them a warner from among themselves; so the infidels Say: this is a thing wondrous!
verse.verse_3: Shell We be brought back when we are dead and have become dust? That is a return remote!
verse.verse_4: Surely We know that which the earth consumeth of them, and with Us is, Book preserved.
verse.verse_5: Aye! they belie the truth when it cometh Unto them; wherefore they are in an affair confused.
verse.verse_6: Have they not looked up to the heaven above them, in what wise We have constructed and bedecked it, and that therein is no rift?
verse.verse_7: And the earth! We have spread it forth, and have cast therein firm mountains, and have caused to grow therein of every beauteous kind of plants:
verse.verse_8: An insight and an admonition for every bondman penitent.
verse.verse_9: And We have sent down from the heaven water brest wherewith We have caused gardens to grow and the grain reaped.
verse.verse_10: And tall date-palms laden with clusters ranged.
verse.verse_11: As a provision for our bondmen; and therewith We have quickened a dead land. Even so will be the coming forth.
verse.verse_12: And before them the people of Nuh belied, and so did the dwellers Of Rass and the Thamud.
verse.verse_13: And the A-ad, and Fir'awn. and the brethren of Lut.
verse.verse_14: And the dwellers in the wood, and the people of Tubba. Each one belied the apostles, wherefore fulfilled was My judgement.
verse.verse_15: Are We then wearied with the first creation? Aye! they are in dubiety regarding a new creation.
verse.verse_16: And assuredly We have created man and We know whatsoever his soul whispereth Unto him, and We are nigher Unto him than his jugular vein.
verse.verse_17: Behold! when the two receivers receive-one on the right hand and one on the left a sitter.
verse.verse_18: Not a word he uttereth but there is with him a watcher ready.
verse.verse_19: And the stupor of death will come in truth: this is that which thou hast been shunning.
verse.verse_20: And the trumpet will be blown: this is the Day of the Threatening.
verse.verse_21: And there shall come every soul therewith shall be a driver and a witness.
verse.verse_22: Assuredly thou wast in neglect thereof; now We have removed from off thee thy veil, so thy sight Today is piercing.
verse.verse_23: And his companion will say: this is that which with me is ready.
verse.verse_24: Cast ye twain into Hell every Person rebellious, contumacious.
verse.verse_26: Who set up with Allah another god. So cast him ye twain into the torment severe.
verse.verse_27: His companion will say: O our Lord! caused him not to transgress but he was himself in error far off.
verse.verse_28: Allah will say: wrangle not in My presence, and had already proferred Unto you the threat.
verse.verse_29: The Word will not be changed in My presence, nor am an oppressor at all Unto My bondmen.
verse.verse_30: Mention the Day whereon We shall say Unto the Hell: art thou filled? and it will say: is there yet any addition?
verse.verse_31: And brought nigh will be the Garden Unto the God-fearing, not far-off.
verse.verse_32: This is that which ye were promised: for every oft- returning heedful one.
verse.verse_33: That feareth the Compassionate in the unseen and cometh to Him with a heart penitent:
verse.verse_34: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Abidence.
verse.verse_35: Theirs therein will be whatsoever they list; and with Us will be yet more.
verse.verse_36: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were mightier in power than they, and they traversed the cities! No place of refuge could they find.
verse.verse_37: Verily herein is an admonition Unto him who hath a heart, or giveth ear while he is heedful.
verse.verse_38: And assuredly We created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is in between the twain in six days, and there touched Us naught of weariness.
verse.verse_39: So bear thou patiently with that which they say, and hallow the praise of thine Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting.
verse.verse_40: And in the night-time hallow Him, and also after the prescribed prostration.
verse.verse_41: And hearken thou: the Day whereon the caller will call from a place quite near.
verse.verse_42: The Day whereon they will surely hear the shout - that is the Day of coming forth.
verse.verse_43: Verily We! it is We Who give life and cause death, and Unto Us is the journeying.
verse.verse_44: That shall be the Day whereon the earth will be cleft from off them as they hasten forth. That shall be a gathering Unto Us easy.
verse.verse_45: We are the best Knower of that which they say, and thou art not over them over them tyrant. Wherefore admonish thou by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
